description: Dependency-aware CP1 persistence verification. The host-only pair coordinator, seven-identity history, Base/Sidecar torn-write sweeps and the Sidecar record/header byte-cut sweep are implemented and passed on exact code/test HEAD 78cc46c39b5b7599c894a2a144cea0f649105beb. Project/live and preset-bank lifecycle adapters pass host acceptance. Production project.c/upreset.c call-site wiring, an approved target Sidecar backend, physical Flash/recovery qualification and pair-aware Archive V2 restore remain distinct gates.

stages.title: Felucca Storage A/B foundation
Existing FM6 Voice Bank staging/recovery
Four-part typed Private runtime cache and generation-safe lifecycle
stages.blocker: Typed V1 Private cache now has four independent part banks, canonical per-key domains, defaults fallback, snapshot/atomic compare-and-replace, dirty tracking and generation-safe persistence acknowledgement. This host test validates the runtime primitive only; production project/preset call sites and editor/UI transport remain separate integration work.

stages.title: Sidecar schema, envelope and semantic validation
stages.blocker: Sidecar V1 envelope, identity/length/value validation and frozen P_MC Motion whitelist (103–118) are implemented and covered by the focused host acceptance suite. Production A/B backend and project/preset runtime integration remain separate gates.
stages.enable_when: V1 format implementation and strict host acceptance suite committed together.

stages.title: Exact Base-generation binding
stages.blocker: The internal st_current_meta() helper returns the exact selected, payload-CRC-validated Base copy, sequence, payload CRC and length. The host test compiles the real storage.c and Sidecar V1 source against simulated NOR and proves stale-generation rejection and fallback binding.
stages.enable_when: Real storage metadata helper and exact Base fingerprint acceptance test committed together.

stages.title: Sidecar A/B matching-copy selection
stages.blocker: Implemented explicit validated A/B copy reads in storage.c and orphan-aware Sidecar selector. Host acceptance covers exact Base match, orphan/stale candidates, matching-vs-newest distinction, wrap/tie, malformed records, outer CRC rejection and no-valid-copy initialization.
stages.enable_when: Real explicit A/B copy reader, selector and simulated-NOR acceptance test committed together.

stages.title: Backend-neutral pair coordinator: seven identities, lifecycle semantics and host acceptance
stages.blocker: The reusable coordinator implements Sidecar-first/Base-second ordering, readback validation, generation-bound pair load and Base tombstone erase. Host adapters use real storage.c with a separate test-only Sidecar backend. Coverage includes seven independent Base A/B histories, Rename preserving/rebinding the stored extension, Save As creating an isolated destination identity, torn writes, orphan retry and fallback. No target Flash backend or runtime call sites are connected.

stages.title: Legacy Base-only load compatibility and Sidecar fault policy
stages.blocker: Host acceptance covers valid pair load, missing Sidecar, semantically invalid Sidecar, Base absence and Sidecar I/O fault separation. The caller must apply canonical defaults when LEGACY_FALLBACK is returned; production project.c runtime wiring remains a separate integration gate.

stages.title: CP1.6 Project/Live lifecycle pair adapter
stages.blocker: Host acceptance exercises shared lifecycle orchestration for pair Save/Load, Rename from the stored pair, Save As into an isolated identity, legacy Base-only canonical defaults, Base tombstone erase, and FM6 autosave reservation guard. AC79 compile-only probe is separate. This is not production project.c/autosave_poll() call-site integration and does not provide target Sidecar storage.

stages.title: CP1.7 Preset bank and per-slot Private lifecycle adapter
stages.blocker: Host acceptance exercises full-bank pair save/load, per-slot Private capture and restore, erase clearing only the selected slot, preservation of unrelated slots, Rename/Save As rebinding and legacy Base-only canonical preset defaults. Firmware-side Base-bank occupancy ↔ Sidecar bitmap validation is now implemented and covered by Sidecar V1 host cases. Production upreset.c call-site wiring and target Sidecar backend remain open.

stages.title: Typed project/live and preset-bank Sidecar payload codecs
stages.blocker: Explicit byte codecs map four-part P_MC/Private/Motion payloads and 16-slot preset-bank payloads without C struct padding. Strict host acceptance covers 501-byte project maximum, 210-byte preset payload, roundtrip, malformed lengths and insufficient capacity. Semantic value validation remains in Sidecar V1 validator.

stages.title: Private runtime ↔ project/live and preset-bank Sidecar bridge
stages.blocker: The bridge validates and transfers all four project/live Private parts atomically, and updates/restores individual preset slots without disturbing unrelated slots. It is host-tested and target-compiled separately; production project.c/upreset.c call sites and target storage remain separate gates.

stages.title: Seven-identity Sidecar isolation and preset-slot preservation
stages.blocker: Host-only strict serializer test covers four project identities, Live Autosave, two preset banks, cross-identity rejection and preset slot write/erase preservation. It does not qualify the production Base+Sidecar coordinator.

stages.title: FM6 inactive autosave-sector reservation and autosave deferral
stages.blocker: Storage now reserves the inactive OBJ_AUTOSAVE copy for an FM6 Voice Bank transfer. Host acceptance proves an autosave write is rejected before erase while reserved, FM6 completes and verifies the bank, then autosave resumes after release. Simulated NOR only.

stages.title: Base + Sidecar pair transaction ordering
stages.blocker: The backend-neutral coordinator and exhaustive host fault-injection harness are implemented. The Sidecar record/header byte-cut sweep passed in Fast Regression on exact HEAD 78cc46c39b5b7599c894a2a144cea0f649105beb (run 41734515051). This stage intentionally remains BLOCKED until an approved target Sidecar backend, production runtime integration and the physical Flash/recovery safety gate are complete; no physical address is authorized.

stages.title: Sidecar CRC, schema and semantic integrity
stages.blocker: Host acceptance is independently executable and covers the frozen P_MC Motion whitelist (103–118), legacy E0–E7 exclusion (119–126), Private/MCX/unallocated-ID rejection, envelope integrity and semantic boundaries. Passing this stage proves the V1 validator only; production A/B backend and project/preset runtime integration remain separate gates.

stages.title: Pair recovery and full Sidecar roundtrip
stages.blocker: Backend-neutral generation-bound pair load and simulated recovery are implemented and passed, including the Sidecar record/header byte-cut sweep on exact HEAD 78cc46c39b5b7599c894a2a144cea0f649105beb (run 41734515051). Remaining production gates: project/live/preset runtime pair restore, legacy FUN10 E0–E7 canonical-default handling, and restoration of live engine/runtime caches at actual project and preset load call sites. This stage remains BLOCKED until those paths are integrated and tested.

stages.title: CP1.4.9 Archive V2 offline manifest validation
stages.blocker: Browser-side Archive V2 parser is validated offline only. This stage checks seven identity mappings, Base CRC association, typed payload lengths, malformed/oversized Sidecar rejection and the no-write restore gate. Firmware pair-aware capture/restore remains blocked.

stages.title: Archive V2 pair-aware restore and destination rebinding
stages.blocker: Archive V2 pair-aware restore is not implemented. Archive V1 must remain legacy-only and must not inherit unrelated Sidecar data.

stages.title: Sidecar autosave coordination with FM6 staging ownership
stages.blocker: Base-only FM6 inactive-autosave-copy reservation and autosave deferral are implemented and host-tested. Missing: Sidecar-aware autosave pair transaction coordination with the FM6 staging reservation and final runtime integration.

stages.title: Full focused host regression after all CP1 stages
stages.blocker: This final regression runs only after all preceding CP1 acceptance stages have passed.
stages.enable_when: All preceding stages are ready and pass.
